# Prodigy Security Services
[bold]Security Services[/bold] is the private army of the [textlink="Prodigy Corporation" link="CMUGuideLoreCorporations"]. It polices Prodigy City, conducts search-and-rescue operations and defends the city from rival corporations. To help sustain the company's remaining operations, its soldiers are also contracted out to the far regions of space as the [bold]Prodigy Corporation Security Forces[/bold].
